svg.aria-label: Clients in: synthwerk-widgets and SDK apps call the gateway over HTTP. Provider out: The gateway forwards to Ollama, Anthropic or another provider, chosen by env. Read-only MCP: The gateway reads the other services through read-only MCP tools. It never writes. Events out: Facts go to the NATS bus as events
